category_seo.title: GameFi & Web3 Gaming - Play to Earn | BiuBiu Tools
category_seo.description: Discover Web3 games and GameFi platforms. Play-to-earn games, NFT gaming assets, and blockchain gaming guilds.

faqs.question: What is GameFi?
faqs.answer: GameFi combines gaming with DeFi mechanics. Players earn tokens and NFTs by playing games. Assets are truly owned by players and can be traded or used across different games.

faqs.question: What are popular Web3 games?
faqs.answer: Axie Infinity pioneered the play-to-earn model. Illuvium and Big Time are AAA-grade games. Gods Unchained is a popular trading card game. The space is evolving toward better gameplay experiences.

faqs.question: What are gaming guilds?
faqs.answer: Gaming guilds like YGG and Merit Circle pool resources to help players access expensive gaming NFTs. They provide scholarships to players and share revenues. Useful for games with high entry costs.
